subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept the current-head revisions of the fourteen third-party GitHub Actions that run in secret-bearing, release, security-scanning, and automation workflows?
rationale: The change is mechanically focused with no identified implementation defect, but accepting new executable action revisions in privileged workflows is a repository trust-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept current action revisions
options.body: After rebase and completed checks, approve the pinned upstream SHAs for the current head and merge this PR.

options.title: Hold selected sensitive actions
options.body: Keep the current pins for app-token, publishing, or Codex-agent action revisions until their upstream changes receive separate review.

options.title: Regenerate a smaller batch later
options.body: Close this batch if maintainers prefer independently verified updates rather than accepting the combined revision set.

recommendation.title: Accept current action revisions
recommendation.body: After rebase and completed checks, approve the pinned upstream SHAs for the current head and merge this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a repository-wide workflow and automation trust-boundary decision.
